claims.quote: Familial hemiplegic migraine type 1 (FHM1) is caused by mutations in the CACNA1A gene, encoding neuronal presynaptic Ca(V)2.1 (P/Q-type) Ca(2+) channels.
These channels mediate neurotransmitter release at many central synapses and at the neuromuscular junction (NMJ).
Mutation S218L causes a severe neurological phenotype of FHM and, additionally, ataxia and susceptibility to seizures, delayed brain edema, and fatal coma after minor head trauma.
